content_sections.heading: Gurugram University Adjunct Faculties Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Gurugram University Adjunct Faculties Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for Gurugram University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Adjunct Faculties, specifically for the Media Studies department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Adjunct Faculties?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Adjunct Faculties position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in Interview, meaning candidates can attend the interview directly without prior online application.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 19th August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for Adjunct Faculties?
faq.answer: Eligibility includes being a reputed practitioner, professional, or academician with recognized accomplishments in their field, and possessing qualifications as prescribed by UGC or relevant statutory bodies.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Adjunct Faculties?
faq.answer: The engagement of Adjunct Faculty beyond the age of 65 years is generally discouraged, except for individuals with exceptional academic or industrial backgrounds.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for Adjunct Faculties?
faq.answer: The salary varies based on the equivalent position: Rs 4000/- per day for Professor, Rs 3000/- per day for Associate Professor, and Rs 2000/- per day for Assistant Professor, with monthly ceilings.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Gurugram University located?
faq.answer: Gurugram University is located in Gurugram, Haryana, with the pincode 122003.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find more details about the recruitment?
faq.answer: Detailed terms and conditions, along with the official notification, can be found on the university's official website: www.gurugramuniversity.ac.in.
